naam: Click Cuts (paid Blender add-on that splits a model into parts that fit your 3D printer bed)
doelgroep: People who 3D print models that are too big for their printer bed (busts, cosplay props, terrain, statues) and use Blender to prepare them, FDM or resin.
feiten: Launched 27 Nov 2026 on Gumroad: Standard $19 (intro price until 14 Dec) and Supporter $29. Superhive listing submitted, still in review.
Split to fit: one button cuts the selected model into parts that fit the chosen printer bed, with round pins or disc magnet holes and an engraved part number on the cut faces.
Fit test: a small block with the user's own pin at four clearances; the chosen clearance is kept per printer and material.
Check per part: green (fits, watertight, enough wall around holes), orange or red with the reason. Free cut at any angle, Lay parts flat on export, export STL or 3MF in mm.
Blender 4.2 and newer. A guide page exists at dortus.com/click-cuts/.
Sales so far: 0. Reviews: 0. No free version. No video yet.
We do not own a 3D printer and have never printed a part; we never claim a print test.
Main competitors: Cleave and Split 3D Print on Superhive, SnapSplit ($20 on Superhive, also free on extensions.blender.org).
